final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), above_average AS (SELECT sex, test_count, AVG(test_count) OVER () AS avg_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT sex, test_count, 1.0 * test_count / SUM(test_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_qualifying_total, test_count - avg_count AS above_average FROM above_average WHERE test_count > avg_count
